name: Diffuse Capillary Malformation with Overgrowth
aliases: Diffuse Capillary Malformation with Limb Overgrowth

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diffuse Capillary Malformation with Overgrowth Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of widespread, reticulated, pink to red capillary malformations involving multiple body regions
Asymmetric soft tissue and/or bony overgrowth of affected limbs or body segments
Lack of associated venous or lymphatic malformations differentiating from other vascular overgrowth syndromes

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Diffuse capillary malformations plus segmental overgrowth with exclusion of other vascular malformation syndromes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical; imaging and genetic testing may assist in excluding other entities.

pathognomonic.notes: Typically pink to red, involving large body areas
searchTerms: widespread net-like skin blood vessel marks

pathognomonic.symptomName: Segmental soft tissue and bony overgrowth
searchTerms: localized overgrowth of soft tissue and bone

common.notes: Due to overgrowth of bone and soft tissues

common.symptomName: Prominent superficial veins without venous malformations
common.notes: Visible but not true venous malformations
searchTerms: large veins on skin without abnormalities
mild increase in soft tissue size

occasional.notes: Due to soft tissue overgrowth and imbalance
searchTerms: stiff joints in arms or legs
open sores on affected skin areas
tingling or shooting pain in arms or legs
limb swelling due to lymph blockage

imaging: MRI or ultrasound showing soft tissue and bony overgrowth without venous or lymphatic malformations
other: Clinical examination revealing diffuse capillary malformations with overgrowth

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of venous and lymphatic malformations
Port-wine stains localized rather than diffuse
More prominent limb hypertrophy with varicosities
Progressive asymmetric overgrowth with connective tissue nevi

redFlags: Development of painful ulcerations or infections
Neurological symptoms such as weakness or sensory loss
references: Happle R. Diffuse capillary malformation with overgrowth: a distinct vascular anomaly. Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases. 2020.
Orphanet: Diffuse Capillary Malformation with Overgrowth (ORPHA:714737).
Wassef M, Blei F, Adams D, et al. Vascular anomalies classification: recommendations from the International Society for the Study of Vascular Anomalies. Pediatrics. 2015.
